Slot-free re-inference — every method past step 3k

Verdict: the channel architecture (expC, slot-free, τ.85) is in a different league in unseen regions — real balustrades, stone walls, textured floors — at a ~0.8dB seen-PSNR cost vs the SDEdit-only models. baseline r128 (uniform) takes best seen-PSNR but its unseen regions are catastrophically gray (−10.4/−4.2): capacity cannot substitute for the noise field. Cluster-128 τ (adaptive trust regions) confirmed as the new inference default; fixed rectangular patches retired (−17.8 collapse on shop). Memory slots removed everywhere — disabling them alone nearly doubled unseen content energy (−28→−51 same ckpt).
